purpose: Independent artifact review of the approved user-enablement consolidation; fixed before first review

grade_bands.A: 95-100 with no blocking findings and all acceptance obligations met
grade_bands.B: 85-94 or a material unmet acceptance obligation
grade_bands.HOLD: required evidence unavailable or a blocking authority/safety/deterministic failure

acceptance_obligations: Global instructions enable a capable product owner without assuming technical expertise or suppressing requested expert depth.
Routine engineering proceeds autonomously; consequential decisions have supported recommendations, understandable tradeoffs, and preserved approval boundaries.
Useful product/design challenge, meaningful replacement, and concrete exploratory artifacts remain possible without mandatory alternatives or uncontrolled scope.
Questions, task understanding, and final explanations have one owner; specialized procedures retain their substantive evidence and local controls without repeated ceremony.
All 13 project rulebooks are reviewed for this change; retained domain authorities and safety boundaries have a recorded disposition.
Model portability separates shared quality requirements from dated, conditional runtime adjustments; no unmeasured fleet-wide qualification claim.
Regeneration, recursive reference closure, repository gates, and focused response evidence are reported at their actual level. Failures and uncertainty remain visible.
review_rules: Inspect actual baseline-to-final artifacts, disposition map, and validation receipts. Score existing dimensions without changing their weights. Return cited deductions, blockers, unmet obligations, numeric score and grade. Keep every valid review. Re-review only substantive corrections or new relevant evidence; never rerun unchanged work to select a favorable verdict. Response smoke tests cannot establish execution behavior or production model parity.
